spans.s: मश् vi. 1P (pres. मशति) 1. To be angry; 2. to sound, to make noise.
मष् vt. 1P (pres. मषति) To kill, to destroy, to hurt.
मस् vt. or vi. 4P (pres. मस्यति) 1. To weigh, to measure; 2. to become changed.
मास् m. The same as मास q.v.(This word has no forms for the first five cases; according to some, it is not a separate word but an optional substitute for मास.)
मश m. 1. A mosquito; 2. humming; 3. anger.
माष m. 1. A kind of bean; (the sing. is used for the plant, the pl. for the seed); 2. a fool, a blockhead; 3. a particular weight, (माषो विंशति मो भागः पणस्य परिकीर्तितः).
मास m.n. 1. A month (either चांद्र, सौर, सावन, नाक्षत्र or बार्हस्पत्य), मासान् गमय चतुरो लोचने मालयित्वा Megh.ii.47; 2. the number ‘twelve.’
मश-हरी f. a musquito-curtain.
मशक m. 1. A mosquito, a gnat, M.i.40, 45; 2. a particular disease of the skin; 3. a leathern vessel for bolding water.
मासक m. A month.
मशक-कुटि, -कुटी ऋ।, -वरण न्। f. a whisk for scaring musquitoes.
मशक-कुटि, -कुटी ऋ।, -वरण न्। f. a whisk for scaring musquitoes.
मशक-वरण n. a whisk for scaring musquitoes.
मशक-हरी f. a musquito-curtain.
मशकिन् m. the Udumbara tree.
मशुन m. A dog.
मषि f. The same as मसी q.v.
मषि f. The same as मसी q.v.
मसि m.f. 1. Ink; 2. lamp-black; 3. a black powder used as a collyrium.
मसी f. The same as मसि q.v.
मसन n. 1. Measuring, weighing; 2. a species of medicinal plant.
मसरा f. A kind of pulse.
मसार m. An emerald.
मासर m. The scum of boiled rice.
मसार m. An emerald.
मसि-आधार m. an ink-bottle, an inkstand.
मसि-कूपी f. an ink-bottle, an inkstand.
मसि-धान n. an ink-bottle, an inkstand.
मसि-धानी f. an ink-bottle, an inkstand.
मसी-धानी f. an ink-bottle.
मसि-मणि f. an ink-bottle, an inkstand.
मसि-जल n. ink.
मसी-जल n. ink.
मसि-पण्य m. a writer, a scribe.
मसि-पथ m. a pen.
मसि-प्रसू f. 1. pen; 2. an ink-bottle.
मसि-वर्धन n. myrrh.
मसिक m. A serpent’s hole.
माषिक a. (f. की) Worth one Māsha.
मासिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Relating to a month; 2. happening every month; 3. lasting for a month; 4. payable in a month; 5. engaged for a month.
मासिक (II) n. A funeral rite performed every new-moon during the first year of the death of a man.
मसु(सू)र m. 1. A kind of pulse; 2. a pillow.
मसु(सू)र m. 1. A kind of pulse; 2. a pillow.
मसु(सू)रा f. 1. A lentil; 2. harlot.
मसु(सू)रा f. 1. A lentil; 2. harlot.
मसूरिका f. 1. A kind of small-pox; 2. a musquito-curtain; 3. a procuress, a bawd.
मसूरी f. A kind of small-pox.
मासुरी f. A beard.
मसृण a. (f. णा) 1. Soft, tender; 2. unctuous, अद्यापि तां मसृणचंदनचर्चितांगीम् Ch.
, सरसमसृनमपि मलयजपंकम् Git.G.iv.; 3. sweet, soft, भण मसृणवाणि करवाणि चरणद्वयं सरसलसदलक्तकरागम् Git.G.x.
मसृण a. (f. णा) 1. Soft, tender; 2. unctuous, अद्यापि तां मसृणचंदनचर्चितांगीम् Ch.
, सरसमसृनमपि मलयजपंकम् Git.G.iv.; 3. sweet, soft, भण मसृणवाणि करवाणि चरणद्वयं सरसलसदलक्तकरागम् Git.G.x.
मसृणा f. Linseed.
मस्क् vt. 1P (pres. मस्कति) To go, to move.
मस्कर m. 1. A bamboo; 2. a hollow bamboo; 3. going, moving, motion; 4. knowledge.
मस्करिन् m. An ascetic, a Brāhmaṇa in the fourth order, धारयन् मस्करिव्रतम् Bt.v.63.

मस्ज् vt. or vi. 6P (pp. मग्न; pres. मज्जति; desid. मिमङ्क्षति) 1. To bathe, to be immersed in water, R.xv.101; 2. to perish in water, to be drowned; 3. to sink into, to sink down, to sink under, सोसंवृतं नाम तमः सह तेनैव मज्जति M.iv.81, R.xvi.72; 4. to sink into misfortune; 5. to be disheartened.With उद्-, to come out of water, वन्यः सरित्तो गज उन्ममज्ज R.v.43, xvi.79, Sis.ix.30.With नि-, 1. to sink into, to sink under, to sink down, यथा प्लवेनौपलेन निमज्जत्युदके तरन् M.iv.194, Bt.iii.30; 2. to disappear, to escape notice, to lose importance, एको हि दोषो गुणसन्निपाते निमज्जतीन्दो किरणेष्विवांकः K.S.i.3.
मस्त n. The head.
मस्त-दारु n. the Devadāru tree.
मस्त-मूलक n. the neck.
मस्तक m.n. 1. The head, M.xi.43; 2. the head or top of anything, न नदीतीरमासाद्य न च पर्वतमस्तके M.iv.47.
मस्तक-आख्य m. the top of a tree.
मस्तक-ज्वर m. headache.
मस्तक-शूल n. headache.
मस्तक-पिंडक m.n. a protuberance on the temples of an elephant in rut.
मस्तक-मूलक n. the neck.
मस्तक-स्नेह m. the brain.
मस्तिक n. The head.
मस्तिष्क m.n. The brain.
मस्तिष्क-त्वच् f. the membrane surrounding the brain.
मस्तु n. 1. Whey; 2. sour cream.
मस्तु-लुंग, -लुंगक m.n. the brain.
मस्तु-लुंग, -लुंगक m.n. the brain.

माष-ऊन a. less by a māsha.

माषिक a. (f. की) Worth one Māsha.

माषीण n. A field of kidney-beans.
माषीण n. A field of kidney-beans.
मास-अनुमासिक a. monthly.
मास-अंत m. the day of new moon.

मास-जात a. born a month ago.
मास-ज्ञ m. a kind of gallinule.
मास-देय a. to be paid in a month.

मास-प्रवेश m. the beginning of a month.
